text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than a thousand people were stranded in 50 buses and trucks stuck in mud on Mozambique's main north-south highway following torrential rain.

- Police in the west-central Mozambican province of Manica have found three large arms caches containing hundreds of mortar shells, crates of landmines and 71 assault rifles, according to Beira's Diario de Mocambique.
